description: Source code for window management functions in a graphics or GUI library, including window creation, saving window content as an image, and frame rate control.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a new window with specified width, height, and optional depth mode, and sets up the window title based on a 'sketch' global variable.

methods.name: saveWindow
methods.description: Captures the current window content and saves it as an image file (PNG, BMP, or JPG) based on the file extension provided.

methods.name: frameRate
methods.description: Gets or sets the target frame rate for rendering.

methods.name: lu5_update_window_size
methods.description: Updates the global variables and internal state with the new window size.
